git -C $repo fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
$deleted=@();$skipped=@();$failed=@()
foreach($t in $targets){
  $line=@(git -C $repo ls-remote --heads origin ('refs/heads/'+$t.b))
  if(!$line.Count){$skipped += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$t.b;reason='already-absent'};continue}
  $actual=($line[0] -split '\s+')[0]
  if($actual -ne $t.s){$skipped += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$t.b;reason='tip-changed';expected=$t.s;actual=$actual};continue}
  git -C $repo push origin (':refs/heads/'+$t.b) | Out-Null
  if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){$deleted += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$t.b;reason=$t.why}} else {$failed += $t.b}
}
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
$remaining=@(git -C $repo for-each-ref --format='%(refname:strip=3)' refs/remotes/origin | Where-Object {$_ -and $_ -notin @('HEAD','main')})
[pscustomobject]@{deleted=$deleted;skipped=$skipped;failed=$failed;remaining=$remaining;remaining_count=$remaining.Count;main=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim()} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
